# Liveness oracle for the `sessions/` test-data directory.
#
# PROVENANCE: SYNTHETIC — this file has no counterpart on disk. It exists
# because tests MUST NOT probe live pids (a pid in this data could collide with a
# real process on the test machine, and the answer would then depend on what
# else is running). The implementation must therefore accept an injected
# liveness oracle; see api-surface.md, capability C2.
#
# Every pid that appears as a file in sessions/ is listed here exactly once,
# with the answer the oracle must give. Nothing else is live.
#
# FORMAT: <pid> <alive|dead>   — '#' begins a comment, blank lines ignored.

98198 alive
98693 alive
1724  alive
15775 alive
1828  alive

98299 alive

# pids are listed, with DIFFERENT answers, so that a test can detect which one
# the implementation used. See test-plan.md, criterion R1.2c, and the
# ambiguity raised in api-surface.md §4.
